- A 6‑character code (letters/numbers) usually labeled “Confirmation code” or “Record locator”

2) Cancel on jetblue.com  
- Go to: jetblue.com  
- Click “Manage trips” or “Manage trips / Check in”  
- Enter:
  - Confirmation code (the 6‑character one)
  - Last name: Reyes  
- Open your November 1, 2026 round‑trip itinerary  
- Choose “Cancel” or “Change/Cancel” and select to cancel the **entire trip**, not just one segment  
- Review what JetBlue shows for:
  - Refund vs. travel credit
  - Any fees (depends on fare type)  
- Confirm the cancellation and save or screenshot the confirmation page/email.

3) Or cancel in the JetBlue app  
- Open the app → “Trips” or “Manage trips”  
- Sign in to your TrueBlue account (if you used one) **or** tap “Find trip” and enter the confirmation code + Reyes  
- Open the Nov 1, 2026 trip → tap “Cancel” → confirm cancellation of the whole round trip.
